The Drive JSON at pfem_run/zeroshot_B1_neo_hookean/pareto_B1_neo_hookean.json now holds run4, which overwrote run3 -- run3's timings survive only here. Per-sample std fields the script also writes were not printed and are therefore absent rather than guessed.
